question: How many deciduous (milk) teeth does a child have?
question_ne: बच्चामा दूधे दाँत कति हुन्छन्?
explanation: A child has 20 deciduous teeth: 8 incisors, 4 canines and 8 molars.
explanation_ne: बच्चामा २० दूधे दाँत हुन्छन्: ८ इन्साइजर, ४ क्यानाइन र ८ मोलर।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: How many canines are there in the permanent dentition?
question_ne: स्थायी दाँतमा क्यानाइन कति हुन्छन्?
explanation: There are 4 canines in the permanent dentition, one in each quadrant.
explanation_ne: स्थायी दाँतमा ४ क्यानाइन हुन्छन्, प्रत्येक चतुर्थांशमा एक।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: How many molars are there in the permanent dentition, including wisdom teeth?
question_ne: बुद्धि दाँतसहित स्थायी दाँतमा मोलर कति हुन्छन्?
explanation: There are 12 molars including the four third molars (wisdom teeth).
explanation_ne: बुद्धि दाँतसहित १२ मोलर हुन्छन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Wisdom teeth are which molars?
question_ne: बुद्धि दाँत कुन मोलर हुन्?
explanation: Wisdom teeth are the third molars, the last teeth to erupt.
explanation_ne: बुद्धि दाँत तेस्रो मोलर हुन्, सबैभन्दा पछि निस्कने दाँत।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: In the FDI notation, which tooth is 11?
question_ne: FDI सङ्केतमा ११ नम्बरको दाँत कुन हो?
explanation: In FDI notation, 11 is the upper right central incisor (quadrant 1, tooth 1).
explanation_ne: FDI सङ्केतमा ११ माथिल्लो दायाँ केन्द्रीय इन्साइजर हो (चतुर्थांश १, दाँत १)।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: In the FDI notation, which quadrant is the upper left?
question_ne: FDI सङ्केतमा माथिल्लो बायाँ कुन चतुर्थांश हो?
explanation: Quadrant 2 is the upper left; quadrant 1 is upper right, 3 lower left and 4 lower right.
explanation_ne: चतुर्थांश २ माथिल्लो बायाँ हो; १ माथिल्लो दायाँ, ३ तल्लो बायाँ र ४ तल्लो दायाँ हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dental caries is mainly caused by the action of what on tooth enamel?
question_ne: दन्त क्यारिज मुख्यतया के ले इनामेलमा असर गरेर हुन्छ?
options: Acid produced by bacteria from sugars
explanation: Bacteria ferment sugars to acid, which demineralises enamel and forms a cavity.
explanation_ne: जीवाणुले चिनीलाई किण्वन गरी एसिड बनाउँछन्, जसले इनामेल खियाएर प्वाल बनाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which mineral in toothpaste helps prevent dental caries?
question_ne: दाँतको क्यारिज रोक्न टुथपेस्टमा कुन खनिज हुन्छ?
explanation: Fluoride strengthens enamel and promotes remineralisation, reducing caries.
explanation_ne: फ्लोराइडले इनामेल बलियो बनाउँछ र पुनः खनिजीकरण बढाएर क्यारिज घटाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Excess fluoride during tooth development causes which condition?
question_ne: दाँत विकास हुँदा अधिक फ्लोराइडले कुन अवस्था हुन्छ?
explanation: Excess fluoride while teeth are forming causes dental fluorosis, seen as white or brown mottling of enamel.
explanation_ne: दाँत बन्दै गर्दा अधिक फ्लोराइडले दन्त फ्लोरोसिस हुन्छ, इनामेलमा सेतो वा खैरो दाग देखिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Inflammation of the gums without loss of attachment is called what?
question_ne: गिजा सुन्निने तर अडान नगुम्ने अवस्थालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Gingivitis is reversible inflammation of the gums caused by plaque, without loss of the tissues that support the tooth.
explanation_ne: जिन्जिभाइटिस प्लाकले हुने गिजाको सुजन हो, दाँतलाई सहयोग गर्ने तन्तु नगुमीकन हुन्छ र यो निको हुन सक्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Hardened dental plaque is called what?
question_ne: कडा भएको दन्त प्लाकलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Plaque that mineralises becomes calculus (tartar), which can only be removed by professional scaling.
explanation_ne: खनिजीकृत प्लाक क्याल्कुलस (टार्टर) बन्छ, जुन व्यावसायिक स्केलिङबाट मात्र हट्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Scaling in dentistry is done to remove what?
question_ne: दन्त चिकित्सामा स्केलिङ के हटाउन गरिन्छ?
explanation: Scaling removes calculus and plaque from the tooth surfaces, especially below the gum line.
explanation_ne: स्केलिङले दाँतको सतह, विशेष गरी गिजामुनिबाट क्याल्कुलस र प्लाक हटाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Inflammation of the dental pulp is called what?
question_ne: दाँतको पल्प सुन्निनुलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Pulpitis is inflammation of the pulp, often from deep caries, and causes toothache.
explanation_ne: पल्पाइटिस पल्पको सुजन हो, प्रायः गहिरो क्यारिजबाट हुन्छ र दाँत दुख्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Root canal treatment is performed to treat disease of which tissue?
question_ne: रूट क्यानल उपचार कुन तन्तुको रोगको लागि गरिन्छ?
explanation: Root canal treatment removes infected or inflamed pulp and seals the root canal.
explanation_ne: रूट क्यानल उपचारले संक्रमित वा सुन्निएको पल्प हटाएर रूट क्यानल बन्द गर्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A dental abscess is best described as what?
question_ne: दन्त एब्सेसलाई सबैभन्दा राम्रोसँग कसरी वर्णन गरिन्छ?
options: A collection of pus from bacterial infection
explanation: A dental abscess is a localised collection of pus caused by bacterial infection, usually at the tooth root.
explanation_ne: दन्त एब्सेस जीवाणु संक्रमणबाट बनेको पिपको स्थानीय थुप्रो हो, प्रायः दाँतको जरामा हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Misalignment of teeth or an incorrect bite is called what?
question_ne: दाँतको गलत मिलान वा गलत टोकाइलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Malocclusion is misalignment of the teeth or an incorrect relationship between the upper and lower teeth when the jaws close.
explanation_ne: म्यालअक्लुजन दाँतको गलत मिलान वा बङ्गारा बन्द हुँदा माथिल्लो र तल्लो दाँतको गलत सम्बन्ध हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Orthodontic treatment mainly corrects what?
question_ne: अर्थोडोन्टिक उपचारले मुख्यतया के सच्याउँछ?
explanation: Orthodontics uses braces and appliances to straighten teeth and correct jaw alignment.
explanation_ne: अर्थोडोन्टिक्सले ब्रेस र उपकरण प्रयोग गरी दाँत सोझ्याउँछ र बङ्गाराको मिलान सच्याउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Grinding or clenching of teeth, often during sleep, is called what?
question_ne: प्रायः निद्रामा दाँत किट्ने वा पिस्ने बानीलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Bruxism is involuntary grinding or clenching of the teeth, often during sleep, which can wear enamel.
explanation_ne: ब्रुक्सिज्म अनैच्छिक रूपमा दाँत किट्ने वा पिस्ने बानी हो, प्रायः निद्रामा हुन्छ र यसले इनामेल खियाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dry mouth due to reduced saliva is called what?
question_ne: र्‍याल कम भएर मुख सुख्खा हुने अवस्थालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Xerostomia is dry mouth caused by reduced saliva flow; it increases the risk of caries.
explanation_ne: जेरोस्टोमिया र्‍याल कम भएर मुख सुख्खा हुने अवस्था हो; यसले क्यारिजको जोखिम बढाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Persistent bad breath is called what?
question_ne: लगातार मुख गन्हाउने अवस्थालाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Halitosis is persistent bad breath, often from poor oral hygiene, gum disease or tongue coating.
explanation_ne: ह्यालिटोसिस लगातार मुख गन्हाउनु हो, प्रायः खराब मौखिक सरसफाइ, गिजाको रोग वा जिब्रोको लेपबाट हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A complete loss of all natural teeth is called what?
question_ne: सबै प्राकृतिक दाँत गुम्नुलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Edentulism is the loss of all natural teeth; it is usually managed with complete dentures or implants.
explanation_ne: इडेन्टुलिज्म सबै प्राकृतिक दाँत गुम्नु हो; यसलाई प्रायः पूर्ण डेन्चर वा इम्प्लान्टबाट व्यवस्थापन गरिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A removable replacement for missing teeth is called what?
question_ne: हराएका दाँतको हटाउन मिल्ने प्रतिस्थापनलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: A denture is a removable appliance that replaces missing teeth and surrounding tissues.
explanation_ne: डेन्चर हराएका दाँत र वरपरका तन्तु प्रतिस्थापन गर्ने हटाउन मिल्ने उपकरण हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A cap placed over a damaged tooth to restore its shape is called what?
question_ne: क्षतिग्रस्त दाँतमाथि राखिने टोपी (क्याप) लाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: A crown is a cap that covers a damaged tooth to restore its shape, strength and appearance.
explanation_ne: क्राउन क्षतिग्रस्त दाँतलाई ढाक्ने टोपी हो, जसले आकार, बल र रूप पुनर्स्थापना गर्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A dental implant is usually made of which metal?
question_ne: दन्त इम्प्लान्ट प्रायः कुन धातुबाट बनेको हुन्छ?
explanation: Dental implants are usually made of titanium, which bonds well with bone (osseointegration).
explanation_ne: दन्त इम्प्लान्ट प्रायः टाइटानियमबाट बनेको हुन्छ, जुन हाडसँग राम्रोसँग जोडिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which vitamin is essential for calcium absorption and healthy teeth and bones?
question_ne: क्याल्सियम अवशोषण र स्वस्थ दाँत-हाडका लागि कुन भिटामिन आवश्यक छ?
explanation: Vitamin D is needed for calcium absorption; its deficiency weakens teeth and bones.
explanation_ne: भिटामिन डी क्याल्सियम अवशोषणका लागि चाहिन्छ; यसको कमीले दाँत र हाड कमजोर हुन्छन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A white patch inside the mouth that cannot be scraped off and is linked to tobacco use is called what?
question_ne: मुखभित्रको सेतो दाग जुन पुछेर हट्दैन र सुर्ती सेवनसँग सम्बन्धित छ, त्यसलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Leukoplakia is a white patch on the oral mucosa, often linked to tobacco, that cannot be scraped off and may be precancerous.
explanation_ne: ल्युकोप्लाकिया मुखको श्लेष्मा झिल्लीमा हुने सेतो दाग हो, प्रायः सुर्तीसँग सम्बन्धित, पुछेर हट्दैन र क्यान्सरपूर्व हुन सक्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Oral thrush is most commonly caused by which organism?
question_ne: मुखको थ्रस प्रायः कुन जीवले गराउँछ?
explanation: Oral thrush (candidiasis) is a fungal infection caused by Candida albicans, seen as creamy white patches.
explanation_ne: मुखको थ्रस (क्यान्डिडियासिस) क्यान्डिडा एल्बिकान्सले हुने फंगल संक्रमण हो, सेतो दहीजस्तो दाग देखिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The first permanent molar usually erupts at about what age?
question_ne: पहिलो स्थायी मोलर प्रायः कति वर्षको उमेरमा निस्कन्छ?
explanation: The first permanent molar usually erupts at about 6 years of age, behind the deciduous molars.
explanation_ne: पहिलो स्थायी मोलर प्रायः ६ वर्षको उमेरमा दूधे मोलरको पछाडि निस्कन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which local anaesthetic is most commonly used in dentistry?
question_ne: दन्त चिकित्सामा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने स्थानीय एनेस्थेटिक कुन हो?
explanation: Lidocaine (lignocaine), often with adrenaline, is the most commonly used local anaesthetic in dentistry.
explanation_ne: लिडोकेन (लिग्नोकेन), प्रायः एड्रेनालिनसहित, दन्त चिकित्सामा सबैभन्दा बढी प्रयोग हुने स्थानीय एनेस्थेटिक हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A panoramic dental X-ray is also known as what?
question_ne: पानोरामिक दन्त एक्स-रे लाई के पनि भनिन्छ?
explanation: A panoramic X-ray (OPG/orthopantomogram) shows the whole mouth, both jaws and all teeth in one image.
explanation_ne: पानोरामिक एक्स-रे (ओपीजी) ले एउटै तस्बिरमा पूरै मुख, दुवै बङ्गारा र सबै दाँत देखाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which imaging technique gives a three-dimensional view of teeth and jaws?
question_ne: दाँत र बङ्गाराको त्रिआयामिक दृश्य दिने इमेजिङ प्रविधि कुन हो?
explanation: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) gives a 3D view of teeth, jaws and surrounding bone.
explanation_ne: कोन-बीम कम्प्युटेड टोमोग्राफी (सीबीसीटी) ले दाँत, बङ्गारा र वरपरको हाडको त्रिआयामिक दृश्य दिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A bitewing X-ray is mainly used to detect what?
question_ne: बाइटविङ एक्स-रे मुख्यतया के पत्ता लगाउन प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: Bitewing X-rays show the crowns of upper and lower teeth together and are best for detecting caries between teeth.
explanation_ne: बाइटविङ एक्स-रेले माथिल्लो र तल्लो दाँतको मुकुट सँगै देखाउँछ र दाँतबीचको क्यारिज पत्ता लगाउन उत्तम हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The recommended brushing time for effective cleaning is about how long?
question_ne: प्रभावकारी सफाइका लागि सिफारिस गरिएको ब्रस गर्ने समय कति हो?
explanation: Brushing for about 2 minutes, twice a day, with fluoride toothpaste is recommended.
explanation_ne: फ्लोराइड टुथपेस्टले दिनमा दुई पटक करिब २ मिनेट ब्रस गर्न सिफारिस गरिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dental floss is used mainly to clean where?
question_ne: डेन्टल फ्लस मुख्यतया कहाँ सफा गर्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: Floss cleans between teeth where a toothbrush cannot reach, removing plaque and food debris.
explanation_ne: फ्लसले दाँतबीच सफा गर्छ जहाँ ब्रस पुग्दैन, प्लाक र खानाका कण हटाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Inflammation around a partially erupted wisdom tooth is called what?
question_ne: आंशिक रूपमा निस्किएको बुद्धि दाँत वरपरको सुजनलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Pericoronitis is inflammation of the gum around a partially erupted tooth, most often a lower wisdom tooth.
explanation_ne: पेरिकोरोनाइटिस आंशिक रूपमा निस्किएको दाँत, प्रायः तल्लो बुद्धि दाँत वरपरको गिजाको सुजन हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A small painful ulcer inside the mouth that heals in 1–2 weeks is most likely what?
question_ne: मुखभित्रको सानो पीडादायी घाउ जुन १–२ हप्तामा निको हुन्छ, त्यो के होला?
explanation: An aphthous ulcer (mouth ulcer) is a small painful sore inside the mouth that usually heals within 1–2 weeks.
explanation_ne: एफ्थस अल्सर (मुखको घाउ) मुखभित्रको सानो पीडादायी घाउ हो जुन प्रायः १–२ हप्तामा निको हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dental sealants are applied mainly to which teeth to prevent caries?
question_ne: दन्त सिलेन्ट मुख्यतया कुन दाँतमा क्यारिज रोक्न लगाइन्छ?
explanation: Sealants are thin coatings applied to the chewing surfaces of molars, where pits and fissures trap food and bacteria.
explanation_ne: सिलेन्ट मोलरको चपाउने सतहमा लगाइने पातलो लेप हो, जहाँ खाडलमा खाना र जीवाणु अड्किन्छन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The normal pH of saliva is approximately what?
question_ne: र्‍यालको सामान्य pH लगभग कति हुन्छ?
explanation: Saliva is normally near neutral, about pH 6.2–7.6; below pH 5.5 enamel begins to demineralise.
explanation_ne: र्‍याल सामान्यतया तटस्थ नजिक, करिब pH ६.२–७.६ हुन्छ; pH ५.५ भन्दा तल इनामेल खियाउन थाल्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which instrument is used to examine the mouth and reflect light onto teeth?
question_ne: मुख जाँच्न र दाँतमा प्रकाश परावर्तन गर्न कुन उपकरण प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: A mouth mirror lets the dentist see tooth surfaces indirectly and reflect light into the mouth.
explanation_ne: माउथ मिररले दन्त चिकित्सकलाई दाँतको सतह अप्रत्यक्ष रूपमा हेर्न र मुखमा प्रकाश परावर्तन गर्न दिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dental forceps are used mainly for what?
question_ne: दन्त फोर्सेप्स मुख्यतया केका लागि प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: Dental forceps are used to grip and extract teeth.
explanation_ne: दन्त फोर्सेप्स दाँत समातेर उखेल्न प्रयोग गरिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which material is commonly used for a tooth-coloured filling?
question_ne: दाँतको रङको फिलिङका लागि कुन पदार्थ बढी प्रयोग गरिन्छ?
explanation: Composite resin is a tooth-coloured filling material that bonds to the tooth.
explanation_ne: कम्पोजिट रेजिन दाँतको रङको भर्ने पदार्थ हो जुन दाँतसँग टाँसिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Amalgam filling is an alloy containing which metal?
question_ne: अमलगम फिलिङ कुन धातु भएको मिश्रधातु हो?
explanation: Dental amalgam is an alloy of mercury with silver, tin and copper.
explanation_ne: दन्त अमलगम पारा, चाँदी, टिन र तामाको मिश्रधातु हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The chewing surface of a tooth is called what?
question_ne: दाँतको चपाउने सतहलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: The occlusal surface is the chewing surface of posterior teeth; the incisal edge is the biting edge of front teeth.
explanation_ne: अक्लुजल सतह पछाडिका दाँतको चपाउने सतह हो; अगाडिका दाँतको टोक्ने किनारा इन्साइजर किनारा हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The tongue-side surface of a lower tooth is called what?
question_ne: तल्लो दाँतको जिब्रोतर्फको सतहलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: The lingual surface faces the tongue; the buccal surface faces the cheek.
explanation_ne: लिङ्गुअल सतह जिब्रोतर्फ हुन्छ; बुकल सतह गालातर्फ हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which nerve supplies sensation to the lower teeth?
question_ne: तल्लो दाँतलाई संवेदना दिने स्नायु कुन हो?
explanation: The inferior alveolar nerve, a branch of the mandibular nerve, supplies the lower teeth.
explanation_ne: इन्फेरियर एल्भियोलर स्नायु, म्यान्डिबुलर स्नायुको शाखा, तल्लो दाँतलाई संवेदना दिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which nerve supplies sensation to the upper teeth?
question_ne: माथिल्लो दाँतलाई संवेदना दिने स्नायु कुन हो?
explanation: The superior alveolar nerves, branches of the maxillary nerve, supply the upper teeth.
explanation_ne: सुपेरियर एल्भियोलर स्नायुहरू, म्याक्सिलरी स्नायुका शाखा, माथिल्लो दाँतलाई संवेदना दिन्छन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Gum bleeding on brushing is most often an early sign of what?
question_ne: ब्रस गर्दा गिजाबाट रगत बग्नु प्रायः कुनको प्रारम्भिक संकेत हो?
explanation: Bleeding gums on brushing are most often an early sign of gingivitis from plaque build-up.
explanation_ne: ब्रस गर्दा गिजाबाट रगत बग्नु प्रायः प्लाक जमेर हुने जिन्जिभाइटिसको प्रारम्भिक संकेत हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which dental disease is characterised by deep periodontal pockets?
question_ne: दाँतको कुन रोगमा गहिरो पेरियोडोन्टल पकेट बन्छ?
explanation: Periodontitis causes deep periodontal pockets as attachment and bone are lost around the tooth.
explanation_ne: पेरियोडोन्टाइटिसमा दाँत वरपर अडान र हाड गुम्दा गहिरो पेरियोडोन्टल पकेट बन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A dental hygienist's main role in preventive care is what?
question_ne: निवारक हेरचाहमा दन्त हाइजिनिस्टको मुख्य भूमिका के हो?
options: Cleaning teeth, scaling and oral-health education
options_ne: दाँत सफा गर्ने, स्केलिङ र मौखिक स्वास्थ्य शिक्षा
explanation: A dental hygienist focuses on preventive care: cleaning, scaling, polishing and teaching oral hygiene.
explanation_ne: दन्त हाइजिनिस्टले निवारक हेरचाहमा ध्यान दिन्छन्: सफाइ, स्केलिङ, पालिस र मौखिक सरसफाइ सिकाउने।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which council licenses dental hygienists in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा दन्त हाइजिनिस्टलाई कुन परिषद्ले लाइसेन्स दिन्छ?
explanation: The Nepal Health Professional Council (NHPC) licenses dental hygienists and other allied health professionals.
explanation_ne: नेपाल स्वास्थ्य व्यावसायी परिषद् (NHPC) ले दन्त हाइजिनिस्ट र अन्य सम्बद्ध स्वास्थ्य व्यावसायीलाई लाइसेन्स दिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which toothpaste ingredient helps remineralise early caries?
question_ne: प्रारम्भिक क्यारिजलाई पुनः खनिजीकरण गर्न टुथपेस्टको कुन सामग्रीले सहयोग गर्छ?
explanation: Fluoride promotes remineralisation of early enamel lesions and makes enamel more acid-resistant.
explanation_ne: फ्लोराइडले प्रारम्भिक इनामेल घाउको पुनः खनिजीकरण बढाउँछ र इनामेललाई एसिडप्रति बढी प्रतिरोधी बनाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Sugar-free chewing gum after meals helps oral health mainly by doing what?
question_ne: खानापछि चिनीमुक्त च्युइङ गमले मौखिक स्वास्थ्यमा मुख्यतया के गरेर सहयोग गर्छ?
explanation: Sugar-free gum stimulates saliva, which neutralises acid and helps remineralise enamel.
explanation_ne: चिनीमुक्त गमले र्‍याल बढाउँछ, जसले एसिडलाई तटस्थ गर्छ र इनामेलको पुनः खनिजीकरणमा सहयोग गर्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: The eruption of the first deciduous tooth usually occurs at about what age?
question_ne: पहिलो दूधे दाँत प्रायः कति उमेरमा निस्कन्छ?
explanation: The first deciduous tooth usually erupts at about 6 months of age.
explanation_ne: पहिलो दूधे दाँत प्रायः करिब ६ महिनाको उमेरमा निस्कन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: All deciduous teeth have usually erupted by about what age?
question_ne: सबै दूधे दाँत प्रायः कति उमेरसम्म निस्किसक्छन्?
explanation: All 20 deciduous teeth have usually erupted by about 2–3 years of age.
explanation_ne: सबै २० दूधे दाँत प्रायः २–३ वर्षको उमेरसम्म निस्किसक्छन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which surface of a tooth faces the midline?
question_ne: दाँतको कुन सतह मध्यरेखातर्फ हुन्छ?
explanation: The mesial surface faces the midline of the dental arch; the distal surface faces away from it.
explanation_ne: मेसियल सतह दन्त चापको मध्यरेखातर्फ हुन्छ; डिस्टल सतह त्यसबाट टाढातर्फ हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A tooth that fails to erupt and remains in the jaw is called what?
question_ne: ननिस्कीकन बङ्गारामै रहने दाँतलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: An impacted tooth fails to erupt into its normal position, most commonly a wisdom tooth.
explanation_ne: इम्प्याक्टेड दाँत आफ्नो सामान्य स्थानमा निस्कन सक्दैन, प्रायः बुद्धि दाँत हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: An extra tooth beyond the normal number is called what?
question_ne: सामान्य संख्याभन्दा बढी हुने अतिरिक्त दाँतलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: A supernumerary tooth is an extra tooth beyond the normal number in the dentition.
explanation_ne: सुपरन्युमेररी दाँत सामान्य संख्याभन्दा बढी हुने अतिरिक्त दाँत हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Congenital absence of one or more teeth is called what?
question_ne: जन्मजात रूपमा एक वा बढी दाँत नहुनुलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: Hypodontia is the congenital absence of one or more teeth; complete absence is anodontia.
explanation_ne: हाइपोडोन्टिया जन्मजात रूपमा एक वा बढी दाँत नहुनु हो; पूरै नहुनुलाई एनोडोन्टिया भनिन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which layer of the tooth is sensitive and contains dentinal tubules?
question_ne: दाँतको कुन तह संवेदनशील छ र त्यसमा डेन्टिनल ट्युब्युल हुन्छन्?
explanation: Dentin is softer than enamel, contains microscopic tubules, and is sensitive when exposed.
explanation_ne: डेन्टिन इनामेलभन्दा नरम हुन्छ, त्यसमा सूक्ष्म नली हुन्छन् र खुला हुँदा संवेदनशील हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Dentin hypersensitivity is most often triggered by what?
question_ne: डेन्टिन हाइपरसेन्सिटिभिटी प्रायः के ले ट्रिगर हुन्छ?
options: Cold, hot, sweet or acidic stimuli on exposed dentin
options_ne: खुला डेन्टिनमा चिसो, तातो, गुलियो वा अम्लीय उत्तेजना
explanation: Exposed dentin reacts to cold, heat, sweet or acidic stimuli, causing sharp, short pain.
explanation_ne: खुला डेन्टिन चिसो, तातो, गुलियो वा अम्लीय उत्तेजनामा प्रतिक्रिया दिन्छ र तीखो, छोटो पीडा हुन्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which sterilisation method is standard for dental instruments?
question_ne: दन्त उपकरणका लागि मानक निर्जलीकरण विधि कुन हो?
explanation: Autoclaving — steam sterilisation under pressure — is the standard method for dental instruments.
explanation_ne: अटोक्लेभिङ — दबाबमा बाफद्वारा निर्जलीकरण — दन्त उपकरणका लागि मानक विधि हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Why must dental staff wear gloves, mask and eye protection?
question_ne: दन्त कर्मचारीले पञ्जा, मास्क र आँखा सुरक्षा किन लगाउनुपर्छ?
explanation: Gloves, mask and eye protection are standard precautions against cross-infection between patients and staff.
explanation_ne: पञ्जा, मास्क र आँखा सुरक्षा बिरामी र कर्मचारीबीच क्रस-संक्रमण रोक्ने मानक सावधानी हुन्।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which mouthwash ingredient is effective against plaque and gingivitis?
question_ne: प्लाक र जिन्जिभाइटिस विरुद्ध प्रभावकारी माउथवास सामग्री कुन हो?
explanation: Chlorhexidine is an antiseptic mouthwash effective against plaque bacteria and gingivitis.
explanation_ne: क्लोरहेक्सिडिन प्लाक जीवाणु र जिन्जिभाइटिस विरुद्ध प्रभावकारी एन्टिसेप्टिक माउथवास हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: What is the main cause of tooth loss in adults?
question_ne: वयस्कमा दाँत गुम्नुको मुख्य कारण के हो?
explanation: Periodontal disease is the main cause of tooth loss in adults, ahead of caries.
explanation_ne: पेरियोडोन्टल रोग वयस्कमा दाँत गुम्नुको मुख्य कारण हो, क्यारिजभन्दा अगाडि।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: A fixed replacement for a missing tooth that is cemented to neighbouring teeth is called what?
question_ne: हराएको दाँतको लागि छिमेकी दाँतमा सिमेन्ट गरिने स्थिर प्रतिस्थापनलाई के भनिन्छ?
explanation: A bridge is a fixed prosthesis cemented to neighbouring teeth to replace one or more missing teeth.
explanation_ne: ब्रिज छिमेकी दाँतमा सिमेन्ट गरिने स्थिर कृत्रिम दाँत हो जसले एक वा बढी हराएका दाँत प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which dental condition is a deep hole in the tooth caused by decay?
question_ne: क्षयले दाँतमा बनेको गहिरो प्वाल कुन अवस्था हो?
explanation: A cavity is a hole in the tooth formed when decay destroys enamel and dentin.
explanation_ne: क्याभिटी क्षयले इनामेल र डेन्टिन नष्ट गर्दा दाँतमा बन्ने प्वाल हो।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Pit and fissure sealants protect teeth mainly from what?
question_ne: पिट र फिसर सिलेन्टले दाँतलाई मुख्यतया के बाट जोगाउँछ?
explanation: Sealants fill pits and fissures on chewing surfaces, protecting them from occlusal caries.
explanation_ne: सिलेन्टले चपाउने सतहका खाडल भर्छ र अक्लुजल क्यारिजबाट जोगाउँछ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which group of teeth is used for cutting food?
question_ne: खाना काट्न कुन समूहका दाँत प्रयोग हुन्छन्?
explanation: Incisors have sharp edges for cutting food; canines tear it and molars grind it.
explanation_ne: इन्साइजरको धारिलो किनाराले खाना काट्छ; क्यानाइनले च्यात्छ र मोलरले पिस्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: Which group of teeth is used for grinding food?
question_ne: खाना पिस्न कुन समूहका दाँत प्रयोग हुन्छन्?
explanation: Molars have broad chewing surfaces for grinding food.
explanation_ne: मोलरको फराकिलो चपाउने सतहले खाना पिस्छ।
source: NHPC Dental Hygiene syllabus — Nepal

question: How many doshas are there in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति दोष छन्?
explanation: Ayurveda recognises three doshas: Vata, Pitta and Kapha.
explanation_ne: आयुर्वेदमा तीन दोष छन्: वात, पित्त र कफ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Vata dosha is mainly composed of which two elements?
question_ne: वात दोष मुख्यतया कुन दुई तत्त्वबाट बनेको छ?
explanation: Vata is composed of air (Vayu) and space/ether (Akasha).
explanation_ne: वात वायु र आकाशबाट बनेको छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Pitta dosha is mainly composed of which two elements?
question_ne: पित्त दोष मुख्यतया कुन दुई तत्त्वबाट बनेको छ?
explanation: Pitta is composed of fire (Agni) and water (Jala).
explanation_ne: पित्त अग्नि र जलबाट बनेको छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Kapha dosha is mainly composed of which two elements?
question_ne: कफ दोष मुख्यतया कुन दुई तत्त्वबाट बनेको छ?
explanation: Kapha is composed of earth (Prithvi) and water (Jala).
explanation_ne: कफ पृथ्वी र जलबाट बनेको छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: How many Panchamahabhutas are there in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति पञ्चमहाभूत छन्?
explanation: The five great elements are Akasha (space), Vayu (air), Agni (fire), Jala (water) and Prithvi (earth).
explanation_ne: पाँच महाभूत आकाश, वायु, अग्नि, जल र पृथ्वी हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which of these is NOT one of the Panchamahabhutas?
question_ne: यीमध्ये कुन पञ्चमहाभूत होइन?
explanation: Ojas is the essence of the dhatus, not one of the five great elements.
explanation_ne: ओजस धातुहरूको सार हो, पाँच महाभूतमध्ये एक होइन।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: How many procedures are there in Panchakarma?
question_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा कति प्रक्रिया छन्?
explanation: Panchakarma has five procedures: Vamana, Virechana, Basti, Nasya and Raktamokshana.
explanation_ne: पञ्चकर्ममा पाँच प्रक्रिया छन्: वमन, विरेचन, बस्ति, नस्य र रक्तमोक्षण।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Panchakarma procedure is therapeutic emesis (induced vomiting)?
question_ne: कुन पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रिया उपचारात्मक वमन (बान्ता गराउने) हो?
explanation: Vamana is therapeutic emesis, used mainly for Kapha disorders.
explanation_ne: वमन उपचारात्मक बान्ता हो, मुख्यतया कफ विकारमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Panchakarma procedure is therapeutic purgation?
question_ne: कुन पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रिया उपचारात्मक विरेचन (झाडा गराउने) हो?
explanation: Virechana is therapeutic purgation, used mainly for Pitta disorders.
explanation_ne: विरेचन उपचारात्मक झाडा गराउने प्रक्रिया हो, मुख्यतया पित्त विकारमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Panchakarma procedure is a medicated enema?
question_ne: कुन पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रिया औषधीय बस्ति (एनिमा) हो?
explanation: Basti is the administration of medicated oil or decoction through the rectum, used mainly for Vata disorders.
explanation_ne: बस्ति मलद्वारबाट औषधीय तेल वा काढा दिने प्रक्रिया हो, मुख्यतया वात विकारमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Panchakarma procedure is administered through the nose?
question_ne: कुन पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रिया नाकबाट दिइन्छ?
explanation: Nasya is the administration of medicine through the nose, used for diseases above the neck.
explanation_ne: नस्य नाकबाट औषधि दिने प्रक्रिया हो, घाँटीभन्दा माथिका रोगमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Panchakarma procedure is bloodletting?
question_ne: कुन पञ्चकर्म प्रक्रिया रक्तमोक्षण (रगत निकाल्ने) हो?
explanation: Raktamokshana is therapeutic bloodletting, used for blood-related and Pitta disorders.
explanation_ne: रक्तमोक्षण उपचारात्मक रूपमा रगत निकाल्ने प्रक्रिया हो, रक्त र पित्त विकारमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: The classical text Charaka Samhita mainly deals with which branch?
question_ne: चरक संहिता मुख्यतया कुन शाखासँग सम्बन्धित छ?
explanation: Charaka Samhita is the foremost text of Kaya Chikitsa, the internal medicine branch of Ayurveda.
explanation_ne: चरक संहिता काय चिकित्सा, आयुर्वेदको आन्तरिक चिकित्सा शाखाको प्रमुख ग्रन्थ हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: The classical text Sushruta Samhita mainly deals with which branch?
question_ne: सुश्रुत संहिता मुख्यतया कुन शाखासँग सम्बन्धित छ?
explanation: Sushruta Samhita is the foremost text of Shalya Tantra (surgery); Sushruta is regarded as the father of surgery.
explanation_ne: सुश्रुत संहिता शल्य तन्त्रको प्रमुख ग्रन्थ हो; सुश्रुतलाई शल्यक्रियाका पिता मानिन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Who is regarded as the father of Ayurvedic medicine (Kaya Chikitsa)?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदिक चिकित्सा (काय चिकित्सा) का पिता कसलाई मानिन्छ?
explanation: Charaka, author of Charaka Samhita, is regarded as the father of Ayurvedic medicine.
explanation_ne: चरक संहिताका लेखक चरकलाई आयुर्वेदिक चिकित्साका पिता मानिन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ashtanga Hridaya was written by whom?
question_ne: अष्टाङ्ग हृदय कसले लेखेका हुन्?
explanation: Ashtanga Hridaya, one of the three great texts (Brihat Trayi), was written by Vagbhata.
explanation_ne: अष्टाङ्ग हृदय, तीन महान ग्रन्थ (बृहत् त्रयी) मध्ये एक, वाग्भटले लेखेका हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: The three great texts of Ayurveda (Brihat Trayi) are which?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदका तीन महान ग्रन्थ (बृहत् त्रयी) कुन हुन्?
options: Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita, Ashtanga Hridaya
Charaka Samhita, Bhela Samhita, Kashyapa Samhita
Sushruta Samhita, Ashtanga Sangraha, Madhava Nidana
options_ne: चरक संहिता, सुश्रुत संहिता, अष्टाङ्ग हृदय
चरक संहिता, भेल संहिता, कश्यप संहिता
सुश्रुत संहिता, अष्टाङ्ग संग्रह, माधव निदान
explanation: The Brihat Trayi are Charaka Samhita, Sushruta Samhita and Ashtanga Hridaya.
explanation_ne: बृहत् त्रयी चरक संहिता, सुश्रुत संहिता र अष्टाङ्ग हृदय हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Who is the god of Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदका देवता को हुन्?
explanation: Dhanvantari is regarded as the god of Ayurveda; Ayurveda Day is observed on Dhanteras.
explanation_ne: धन्वन्तरिलाई आयुर्वेदका देवता मानिन्छ; आयुर्वेद दिवस धनतेरसमा मनाइन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ayurveda Day is observed on which day?
question_ne: आयुर्वेद दिवस कुन दिन मनाइन्छ?
explanation: Ayurveda Day is observed every year on Dhanteras (Dhanvantari Jayanti).
explanation_ne: आयुर्वेद दिवस हरेक वर्ष धनतेरस (धन्वन्तरि जयन्ती) मा मनाइन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: How many Dhatus (body tissues) are there in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति धातु (शरीरका तन्तु) छन्?
explanation: The seven dhatus are Rasa, Rakta, Mamsa, Meda, Asthi, Majja and Shukra.
explanation_ne: सात धातु रस, रक्त, मांस, मेद, अस्थि, मज्जा र शुक्र हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which is the first Dhatu formed after digestion?
question_ne: पाचनपछि सबैभन्दा पहिले बन्ने धातु कुन हो?
explanation: Rasa (plasma/nutrient fluid) is the first dhatu formed from digested food.
explanation_ne: रस (प्लाज्मा/पोषक तरल) पचेको खानाबाट बन्ने पहिलो धातु हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Dhatu is bone tissue?
question_ne: हाडको तन्तु कुन धातु हो?
explanation: Asthi is the bone tissue; Majja is bone marrow and nervous tissue.
explanation_ne: अस्थि हाडको तन्तु हो; मज्जा हाडको मासी र स्नायु तन्तु हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Agni in Ayurveda refers to what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा अग्नि भनेको के हो?
explanation: Agni is the digestive and metabolic fire; balanced Agni is essential for health, and weak Agni produces Ama (toxins).
explanation_ne: अग्नि पाचन र चयापचय शक्ति हो; सन्तुलित अग्नि स्वास्थ्यका लागि आवश्यक छ, कमजोर अग्निले आम (विष) बनाउँछ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ama in Ayurveda refers to what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा आम भनेको के हो?
explanation: Ama is undigested, toxic residue from weak digestion; it is considered a root cause of disease.
explanation_ne: आम कमजोर पाचनबाट बनेको नपचेको विषाक्त अवशेष हो; यसलाई रोगको मूल कारण मानिन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Prakriti in Ayurveda means what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा प्रकृति भनेको के हो?
options: A person's innate constitution (dosha balance at birth)
explanation: Prakriti is a person's innate constitution, determined by the dosha balance at birth.
explanation_ne: प्रकृति व्यक्तिको जन्मजात संरचना हो, जन्मदेखिको दोष सन्तुलनले निर्धारण हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Dinacharya in Ayurveda means what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा दिनचर्या भनेको के हो?
explanation: Dinacharya is the daily routine — waking, cleansing, exercise, meals and sleep — recommended for health.
explanation_ne: दिनचर्या स्वास्थ्यका लागि सिफारिस गरिएको दैनिक दिनचर्या हो — उठ्ने, सफाइ, व्यायाम, खाना र निद्रा।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ashwagandha (Withania somnifera) is mainly used in Ayurveda as what?
question_ne: अश्वगन्धा (Withania somnifera) आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया के रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Ashwagandha is a Rasayana (rejuvenative) and adaptogen, used for strength, stress and vitality.
explanation_ne: अश्वगन्धा रसायन (कायाकल्प) र एडाप्टोजेन हो, बल, तनाव र जीवनशक्तिका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Turmeric (Curcuma longa) contains which active compound?
question_ne: बेसार (Curcuma longa) मा कुन सक्रिय यौगिक हुन्छ?
explanation: Turmeric's active compound is curcumin, known for anti-inflammatory action.
explanation_ne: बेसारको सक्रिय यौगिक कुर्कुमिन हो, जुन सूजनरोधी गुणका लागि जानिन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Tulsi (Ocimum sanctum) is known in Ayurveda as what?
question_ne: तुलसी (Ocimum sanctum) आयुर्वेदमा के भनेर चिनिन्छ?
options: Holy Basil, a sacred and medicinal plant
options_ne: पवित्र तुलसी, पवित्र र औषधीय वनस्पति
explanation: Tulsi (Holy Basil) is a sacred plant in Ayurveda, used for respiratory and immune health.
explanation_ne: तुलसी (पवित्र तुलसी) आयुर्वेदमा पवित्र वनस्पति हो, श्वासप्रश्वास र प्रतिरक्षा स्वास्थ्यका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Neem (Azadirachta indica) is mainly valued in Ayurveda for which property?
question_ne: निम (Azadirachta indica) आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया कुन गुणका लागि मूल्यवान छ?
explanation: Neem is valued for its antibacterial, antifungal and blood-purifying properties, especially for skin disorders.
explanation_ne: निम जीवाणुरोधी, फंगलरोधी र रगत शुद्ध गर्ने गुणका लागि मूल्यवान छ, विशेष गरी छालाका रोगमा।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Brahmi (Bacopa monnieri) is mainly used in Ayurveda for what?
question_ne: ब्राह्मी (Bacopa monnieri) आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया केका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Brahmi is a Medhya Rasayana, used to support memory, intellect and brain health.
explanation_ne: ब्राह्मी मेध्य रसायन हो, स्मरणशक्ति, बुद्धि र मस्तिष्क स्वास्थ्यका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Amla (Emblica officinalis) is the richest natural source of which vitamin?
question_ne: अमला (Emblica officinalis) कुन भिटामिनको सबैभन्दा धनी प्राकृतिक स्रोत हो?
explanation: Amla is one of the richest natural sources of vitamin C and is a key Rasayana fruit.
explanation_ne: अमला भिटामिन सी को सबैभन्दा धनी प्राकृतिक स्रोतमध्ये एक हो र प्रमुख रसायन फल हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Guduchi (Tinospora cordifolia) is known in Ayurveda as what?
question_ne: गुडूची (Tinospora cordifolia) आयुर्वेदमा के भनेर चिनिन्छ?
explanation: Guduchi (Giloy) is called Amrita, the nectar, and is used as an immunomodulator and Rasayana.
explanation_ne: गुडूची (गिलोय) लाई अमृत भनिन्छ र यो प्रतिरक्षा नियन्त्रक र रसायनका रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Shatavari (Asparagus racemosus) is mainly used in Ayurveda for what?
question_ne: शतावरी (Asparagus racemosus) आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया केका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Shatavari is a Rasayana for women's reproductive health, lactation and hormonal balance.
explanation_ne: शतावरी महिलाको प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य, दूध उत्पादन र हार्मोनल सन्तुलनका लागि रसायन हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ginger (Zingiber officinale) is known in Ayurveda as what?
question_ne: अदुवा (Zingiber officinale) आयुर्वेदमा के भनेर चिनिन्छ?
explanation: Ginger (Shunthi/Adrak) is a Deepana herb that kindles Agni, aids digestion and relieves nausea.
explanation_ne: अदुवा (सुन्थी/अद्रक) दीपन जडीबुटी हो जसले अग्नि बढाउँछ, पाचनमा सहयोग गर्छ र वान्ता कम गर्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: How many tastes (Rasa) are recognised in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति रस (स्वाद) मानिन्छन्?
explanation: The six tastes are Madhura (sweet), Amla (sour), Lavana (salty), Katu (pungent), Tikta (bitter) and Kashaya (astringent).
explanation_ne: छ रस मधुर (गुलियो), अम्ल (अमिलो), लवण (नुनिलो), कटु (पिरो), तिक्त (तितो) र कषाय (ट्रो) हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which taste (Rasa) increases Kapha most?
question_ne: कुन रसले कफ सबैभन्दा बढी बढाउँछ?
explanation: Sweet taste (Madhura) increases Kapha; pungent, bitter and astringent tastes decrease it.
explanation_ne: गुलियो स्वाद (मधुर) ले कफ बढाउँछ; पिरो, तितो र ट्रो स्वादले घटाउँछ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Abhyanga in Ayurveda is what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा अभ्यङ्ग के हो?
explanation: Abhyanga is a full-body massage with warm medicated oil, part of daily routine and Panchakarma preparation.
explanation_ne: अभ्यङ्ग न्यानो औषधीय तेलले गरिने पूरै शरीरको मालिस हो, दैनिक दिनचर्या र पञ्चकर्म तयारीको भाग।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Shirodhara in Ayurveda is what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा शिरोधारा के हो?
options: Pouring warm oil in a stream over the forehead
explanation: Shirodhara is the continuous pouring of warm oil over the forehead, used for stress, insomnia and mental calm.
explanation_ne: शिरोधारा निधारमाथि निरन्तर न्यानो तेल खन्याउने प्रक्रिया हो, तनाव, अनिद्रा र मानसिक शान्तिका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Shamana in Ayurveda means what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा शमन भनेको के हो?
options: Palliative therapy that pacifies doshas without elimination
options_ne: दोषलाई नहटाई शान्त पार्ने शामक चिकित्सा
explanation: Shamana is palliative treatment that pacifies aggravated doshas in the body without eliminating them.
explanation_ne: शमन शरीरभित्रै बिग्रिएका दोषलाई नहटाई शान्त पार्ने शामक उपचार हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Rasayana in Ayurveda refers to what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा रसायन भनेको के हो?
options: Rejuvenation therapy for longevity and immunity
options_ne: कायाकल्प चिकित्सा — आयु र प्रतिरक्षाका लागि
explanation: Rasayana is rejuvenation therapy that promotes longevity, immunity, memory and vitality.
explanation_ne: रसायन कायाकल्प चिकित्सा हो जसले आयु, प्रतिरक्षा, स्मरणशक्ति र जीवनशक्ति बढाउँछ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Vajikarana in Ayurveda is the branch dealing with what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा वाजीकरण कुनसँग सम्बन्धित शाखा हो?
explanation: Vajikarana deals with reproductive health, aphrodisiacs and vitality.
explanation_ne: वाजीकरण प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य, कामोत्तेजक र जीवनशक्तिसँग सम्बन्धित छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Kaumarabhritya in Ayurveda is the branch dealing with what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कौमारभृत्य कुनसँग सम्बन्धित शाखा हो?
explanation: Kaumarabhritya is the Ayurvedic branch of paediatrics, child health and care.
explanation_ne: कौमारभृत्य आयुर्वेदको बाल चिकित्सा, बाल स्वास्थ्य र हेरचाहको शाखा हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Agada Tantra in Ayurveda deals with what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा अगद तन्त्र कुनसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
explanation: Agada Tantra is the Ayurvedic branch of toxicology, dealing with poisons, bites and antidotes.
explanation_ne: अगद तन्त्र आयुर्वेदको विष विज्ञान शाखा हो, विष, टोकाइ र प्रतिविषसँग सम्बन्धित छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Bhuta Vidya in Ayurveda deals with what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा भूत विद्या कुनसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
explanation: Bhuta Vidya is the Ayurvedic branch dealing with mental illness, spirits and psychiatry.
explanation_ne: भूत विद्या आयुर्वेदको मानसिक रोग, भूत र मनोचिकित्सासँग सम्बन्धित शाखा हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Shalakya Tantra in Ayurveda deals with diseases of which parts?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा शालाक्य तन्त्र कुन भागका रोगसँग सम्बन्धित छ?
options: Eye, ear, nose, throat, head and mouth
options_ne: आँखा, कान, नाक, घाँटी, टाउको र मुख
explanation: Shalakya Tantra deals with diseases of the eye, ear, nose, throat, head and oral cavity (above the neck).
explanation_ne: शालाक्य तन्त्र आँखा, कान, नाक, घाँटी, टाउको र मुख (घाँटीभन्दा माथि) का रोगसँग सम्बन्धित छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: How many branches (Ashtanga) are there in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कति शाखा (अष्टाङ्ग) छन्?
explanation: Ayurveda has eight branches (Ashtanga): Kaya, Bala, Graha, Urdhvanga, Shalya, Damshtra, Jara and Vajikarana.
explanation_ne: आयुर्वेदमा आठ शाखा (अष्टाङ्ग) छन्: काय, बाल, ग्रह, ऊर्ध्वाङ्ग, शल्य, दंष्ट्र, जरा र वाजीकरण।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which council regulates Ayurveda practice in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा आयुर्वेद अभ्यासलाई कुन परिषद्ले नियमन गर्छ?
explanation: The Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council (NAMC) regulates Ayurveda practice and registers Ayurveda practitioners in Nepal.
explanation_ne: नेपाल आयुर्वेद चिकित्सा परिषद् (NAMC) ले नेपालमा आयुर्वेद अभ्यास नियमन गर्छ र आयुर्वेद चिकित्सक दर्ता गर्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: The Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery degree is abbreviated as what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदिक चिकित्सा र शल्यक्रियाको स्नातक उपाधिलाई के भनेर संक्षेप गरिन्छ?
explanation: BAMS is the Bachelor of Ayurvedic Medicine and Surgery degree.
explanation_ne: BAMS आयुर्वेदिक चिकित्सा र शल्यक्रिया स्नातक उपाधि हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which ministry oversees Ayurveda in Nepal?
question_ne: नेपालमा आयुर्वेद कुन मन्त्रालयको मातहत छ?
explanation: Ayurveda in Nepal is overseen by the Ministry of Health and Population, through the Department of Ayurveda and Alternative Medicine.
explanation_ne: नेपालमा आयुर्वेद स्वास्थ्य तथा जनसंख्या मन्त्रालय मातहत, आयुर्वेद तथा वैकल्पिक चिकित्सा विभागमार्फत हेर्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Yoga is recognised in Ayurveda mainly as what?
question_ne: योग आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया के रूपमा मानिन्छ?
options: A practice for physical and mental balance
explanation: Yoga is recognised in Ayurveda as a practice that balances body and mind and supports health.
explanation_ne: योग आयुर्वेदमा शरीर र मनलाई सन्तुलन गर्ने र स्वास्थ्यलाई सहयोग गर्ने अभ्यासका रूपमा मानिन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which dosha is aggravated by cold, dry and irregular routine?
question_ne: चिसो, सुख्खा र अनियमित दिनचर्याले कुन दोष बढ्छ?
explanation: Vata is aggravated by cold, dry, light and irregular factors.
explanation_ne: वात चिसो, सुख्खा, हलुका र अनियमित कारकले बढ्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which dosha is aggravated by heat, spicy food and anger?
question_ne: तातो, पिरो खाना र क्रोधले कुन दोष बढ्छ?
explanation: Pitta is aggravated by heat, spicy and sour food, and anger.
explanation_ne: पित्त तातो, पिरो र अमिलो खाना र क्रोधले बढ्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which dosha is aggravated by cold, damp, heavy food and lack of exercise?
question_ne: चिसो, ओसिलो, भारी खाना र व्यायामको कमीले कुन दोष बढ्छ?
explanation: Kapha is aggravated by cold, damp, heavy and oily food and by inactivity.
explanation_ne: कफ चिसो, ओसिलो, भारी र चिल्लो खाना र निष्क्रियताले बढ्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Srotas in Ayurveda refers to what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा स्रोतस भनेको के हो?
options: Channels that carry nutrients and wastes in the body
options_ne: शरीरमा पोषक र फोहोर बोक्ने नलीहरू
explanation: Srotas are the channels in the body that transport nutrients, dhatus and wastes.
explanation_ne: स्रोतस शरीरमा पोषक, धातु र फोहोर बोक्ने नलीहरू हुन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which is the main site (seat) of Vata dosha?
question_ne: वात दोषको मुख्य स्थान कुन हो?
explanation: The main seat of Vata is the large intestine (Pakvashaya).
explanation_ne: वातको मुख्य स्थान ठूलो आन्द्रा (पक्वाशय) हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which is the main site (seat) of Pitta dosha?
question_ne: पित्त दोषको मुख्य स्थान कुन हो?
explanation: The main seat of Pitta is the small intestine (Grahani), with the stomach as its secondary seat.
explanation_ne: पित्तको मुख्य स्थान सानो आन्द्रा (ग्रहणी) हो, पेट यसको दोस्रो स्थान हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Ghee (clarified butter) is valued in Ayurveda mainly because it does what?
question_ne: घिउ आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया के गर्छ भनेर मूल्यवान छ?
options: Carries medicine into tissues and kindles Agni
options_ne: औषधिलाई तन्तुमा पुर्‍याउँछ र अग्नि बढाउँछ
explanation: Ghee is valued as a carrier (Anupana) that takes medicine deep into tissues and supports Agni.
explanation_ne: घिउ औषधिलाई तन्तुको गहिराइसम्म पुर्‍याउने वाहक (अनुपान) का रूपमा मूल्यवान छ र अग्निलाई सहयोग गर्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Honey in Ayurveda is used mainly as what?
question_ne: मह आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया के रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Honey is used as a carrier (Anupana) for medicines and has its own healing properties; it should not be heated.
explanation_ne: मह औषधिका लागि वाहक (अनुपान) का रूपमा प्रयोग हुन्छ र यसको आफ्नै उपचारात्मक गुण छन्; यसलाई तताउनु हुँदैन।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which herb is known as the 'king of herbs' for liver health in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा कलेजो स्वास्थ्यका लागि 'जडीबुटीका राजा' भनेर कुन जडीबुटी चिनिन्छ?
explanation: Bhumyamalaki is valued in Ayurveda for liver health and jaundice.
explanation_ne: भूम्यामलकी आयुर्वेदमा कलेजो स्वास्थ्य र जन्डिसका लागि मूल्यवान छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Pippali (long pepper) is mainly used in Ayurveda for what?
question_ne: पिप्पली (लामो मरिच) आयुर्वेदमा मुख्यतया केका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ?
explanation: Pippali is used for respiratory disorders, cough and to kindle digestive fire.
explanation_ne: पिप्पली श्वासप्रश्वास रोग, खोकी र पाचन अग्नि बढाउन प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Haritaki is one of the three fruits of Triphala and is known for what?
question_ne: हरीतकी त्रिफलाको तीन फलमध्ये एक हो र केका लागि चिनिन्छ?
explanation: Haritaki is a mild laxative and Rasayana, used for digestion and detoxification.
explanation_ne: हरीतकी हल्का विरेचक र रसायन हो, पाचन र विषहरणका लागि प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which Ayurvedic formulation is a decoction (Kwatha)?
question_ne: कुन आयुर्वेदिक तयारी काढा (क्वाथ) हो?
explanation: Kwatha is a decoction made by boiling herbs in water and reducing it.
explanation_ne: क्वाथ जडीबुटीलाई पानीमा उमालेर घटाएर बनाइने काढा हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Churna in Ayurveda is what form of medicine?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा चूर्ण कुन रूपमा औषधि हो?
explanation: Churna is a fine powder of dried herbs, taken with water, honey or ghee.
explanation_ne: चूर्ण सुकेका जडीबुटीको मसिनो धुलो हो, पानी, मह वा घिउसँग लिइन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Taila in Ayurveda is what form of medicine?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा तैल कुन रूपमा औषधि हो?
explanation: Taila is medicated oil, used for massage, Nasya and Basti.
explanation_ne: तैल औषधीय तेल हो, मालिस, नस्य र बस्तिमा प्रयोग हुन्छ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: The Ayurvedic principle 'Swasthasya Swasthya Rakshanam' means what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदिक सिद्धान्त 'स्वस्थस्य स्वास्थ्य रक्षणम्' को अर्थ के हो?
options: Protect the health of the healthy
explanation: Ayurveda's first aim is to protect the health of the healthy; its second is to cure disease.
explanation_ne: आयुर्वेदको पहिलो उद्देश्य स्वस्थ व्यक्तिको स्वास्थ्य रक्षा गर्नु हो; दोस्रो रोग निको पार्नु हो।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: According to Ayurveda, health is the balance of what?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदअनुसार स्वास्थ्य के को सन्तुलन हो?
explanation: Health is the balance of dosha, agni, dhatu and mala, with a happy mind, senses and soul.
explanation_ne: स्वास्थ्य दोष, अग्नि, धातु र मलको सन्तुलन हो, साथै प्रसन्न मन, इन्द्रिय र आत्मा।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which season is Vata most aggravated in Ayurveda?
question_ne: आयुर्वेदमा वात कुन ऋतुमा सबैभन्दा बढी बढ्छ?
explanation: Vata is aggravated in the rainy and autumn seasons, when cold and dry qualities increase.
explanation_ne: वात वर्षा र शरद ऋतुमा बढ्छ, जब चिसो र सुख्खा गुण बढ्छन्।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal

question: Which taste pacifies Vata dosha?
question_ne: कुन स्वादले वात दोष शान्त गर्छ?
explanation: Sweet, sour and salty tastes pacify Vata; bitter, pungent and astringent tastes aggravate it.
explanation_ne: गुलियो, अमिलो र नुनिलो स्वादले वात शान्त गर्छ; तितो, पिरो र ट्रो स्वादले बढाउँछ।
source: Nepal Ayurveda Medical Council / NHPC Ayurveda syllabus — Nepal
